items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the etale schemes over a field as the disjoint unions of spectra of finite separable field extensions, and deduces that every fibre of an etale morphism is such a disjoint union over the residue field of the point. The proof gives a direct argument from the algebra lemma on etale algebras over a field: in one direction a disjoint union of spectra of finite separable extensions is visibly etale, and conversely each affine open of an etale scheme over the field is a finite disjoint union of such spectra, so all points are closed, the space is discrete, and the structure morphism is the disjoint union of the affine pieces.
